name: phase-runner-hud
description: Experimental Claude Code mod for Phase Runner: the running phase in the status line, a toast when a run needs you, and /phase-status with no model call.

workspace.title: Workspace folder
workspace.description: The folder that holds docs/phases/. Absolute, or relative to the session's directory. Leave empty to use the session's directory.

sound.title: Play a sound with each toast
sound.description: Plays a short chime when a run escalates, hits a blocker or completes a phase. In the terminal, macOS only for now.
